evals.prompt: Giúp tôi viết prompt cho aizen-build: tôi muốn người dùng giữ ghế tàu Tết vài phút trong lúc thanh toán.
evals.expected_output: One round of at most five questions with options and defaults (hold time, expiry behaviour, scope), then one /aizen-build prompt.
expectations: Asks at most five questions in one message, each with options and a marked default
Does not ask about framework, folder layout or test runner
The prompt has Task, Tên nghiệp vụ (e.g. seat-hold), Loại, Mục tiêu, Tiêu chí xong, Phạm vi and Điểm dừng
Has a refusal case for a seat already held (e.g. 409) and an edge case for concurrent holds or expiry
Writes no code and no plan

evals.prompt: Phỏng vấn tôi rồi soạn task sửa lỗi: đăng nhập thỉnh thoảng trả 500.
evals.expected_output: Questions about reproduction, evidence and since when; then a bug prompt with expected vs actual and how to reproduce.
expectations: Asks for a way to reproduce and for evidence (log or request) instead of guessing the cause
The prompt uses Loại: bugfix and a business name without a task code
Pushing, deploying and deleting data are not pre-approved

evals.prompt: Implement the seat hold API with Redis in this repo now.
evals.expected_output: Handled by aizen-build, not by the prompt architect.
expectations: aizen-prompt-architect is not used; the request goes to aizen-build
